# `unsafe-catch-unreachable`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: strict · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports `catch unreachable` on an operation known to be fallible.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A recoverable or propagatable failure becomes a runtime assertion with little
error context.

## When it fires

It is useful where failures should be handled or returned; intentional
impossible-error invariants may warrant an explicit assertion and explanation.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn fail() !void {
    return error.Failed;
}

fn run() !void {
    fail() catch unreachable;
}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Errors>
